notes: Batch is 23 Georgia Tech pages and 4 HEC pages (1 HEC Montreal, 3 HEC Paris). Only one page lists doctoral graduates: the HEC Paris 2019 PhD graduates news item (nine named graduates with areas, including one in Information Systems and Operations Management; the visible list ends with '......', so the captured text may be truncated and the live/other captures should be checked; no employers given). The eleven penlab.gatech.edu pages are master's (MS HCI/Digital Media) project theses in Literature, Media and Communication, not doctoral and not operations. The Temenoff Lab post names one person's dissertation defense and FDA job, but it is a biomedical-engineering lab, outside the population. Institutions by host were kept for every page.
